PERSONAL_STORY.definition: 偶像个人剧情/本人事件, 通常在 week transaction 后插入的对话演出
distinguishers: dialogue presentation blocks return to HOME
PERSONAL_STORY.distinguisher_confidence: LOW — current frames do not yet provide a cheap reliable marker; use EVENT_STORY_UNKNOWN when unsure
PERSONAL_STORY.business_authority: textbox advance only, no semantic choice unless choice overlay appears

SUPPORT_CARD_STORY.definition: 支援卡剧情 / support event (e.g. サポートイベント auto-settle, サポートスキル related scenes)
distinguishers: preceded by サポート caption
auto-settle variant adds stats without choices (0906 S1W2 Da+20)
SUPPORT_CARD_STORY.distinguisher_confidence: MEDIUM (caption observed in prior run logs)

MORNING_3CHOICE.definition: 3-option timed choice overlay (含 morning/advice 类)
MORNING_3CHOICE.business_rule: middle option (CONFIRMED across S1W3-S1W5 of 0906 run: choco研究 middle OK, 猫 middle OK)
subtypes: ADVICE_3CHOICE (audition pre-battle advice: middle CONFIRMED in 0905 S4 auditions)

subtypes.PROMISE_TRUE_BUSINESS_CHOICE: real choice with lasting consequence (e.g. S1W5 智代子レッスン请求 いいよ → 約束事件后顺延, 0905 run)
subtypes.PROMISE_FAST_FORWARDABLE: promise dialogue that SKIP/textbox can fast-forward

PROMISE_STORY.handler_ownership: true BUSINESS_CHOICE owns frame; else promise/constraint Miokuri > fast-forward > textbox

TWO_CHOICE.business_rule: 含ごめん → ごめん (CONFIRMED 0906 S1W3/S1W4, 0905 S2W6)

EVENT_STORY_UNKNOWN.definition: story-type presentation that could not be classified from available frame evidence — use this instead of guessing

eligibility_models.PERSONAL_STORY: UNKNOWN — currently tracked as RAW_EMPIRICAL_RATE over observed post-action transitions

honesty_note: All probabilities are RAW_EMPIRICAL_RATE with ELIGIBILITY_MODEL=UNKNOWN. Do not use as business behavior inputs; observation priors and probe order only.
